_comment: The one list of go-common consumers for .github/workflows/bump-consumers.yml. Per entry: repo (short name in the org), module_dir (directory of the go.mod, relative to the repo root), enabled (default true; false = open nothing, give the reason in note), auto_merge (default true; false = open the PR but never switch on auto-merge), required_checks (check names that must be REQUIRED on main before auto-merge is switched on: the repo's test jobs, as GitHub shows them), deploy_workflow (default deploy.yml: the workflow whose run on the merge commit the job waits for). Edit this file to add or retire a consumer; nothing else lists them.

consumers.note: OPEN NOTHING: geo-service is still on the go-common of 04.11.2026, before release 2 (events.NewDispatcher needs a deduplicator and a group, outbox.New needs a key-hashing writer, ...). A bump there does not compile. Port it by hand, then delete this flag.
PHP repo; its Go module is the outbox relay. The bump touches services/outbox-worker/go.mod and go.sum only. validate is the PHP suite and runs on every PR.
